questions.question: How should the categories be ordered?

options.label: By item count
options.adds: Sort the categories by how many items each has, largest first.

options.label: Custom order
options.adds: Sort the categories in the order I list them in the prompt.

rewriteBeforeAnswers: Sort the categories in the CLI output so they read in a better order. Change only the order they are displayed in, not their contents or anything else in the output. Done when the CLI output shows the categories in the new order.
